summary:
歐特克 EPS 2.99 美元超預期5.2%、營收年增18.4%，設計與製造軟體訂閱動能強勁。
• EPS 2.99 美元，超預期 5.15%，獲利穩健
• 營收 19.3 億美元，年增 18.43%，訂閱動能強
• AEC（建築工程營造）與製造雲端平台滲透提升
• 新交易模式（agency model）轉換推進
ai_view:
訊號正向：營收與獲利雙超預期且維持高雙位數成長，顯示設計與製造軟體訂閱韌性強，雲端與 AI 功能提升黏著度。短期財報利多支撐股價。中期追蹤新交易模式對淨營收的影響、AEC 與製造業景氣、自由現金流轉換、以及營業利潤率擴張。建築景氣與利率為主要週期性變數，29倍本益比尚屬合理。

需留意：建築與營造業景氣對宏觀利率敏感；本益比約29倍，估值不算便宜；交易模式轉換期的收入確認波動

summary_en:
Autodesk beat EPS at $2.99 by 5.2% with 18.4% revenue growth, on strong design and make software subscriptions.
• EPS of $2.99 beat by 5.15%, solid profitability
• Revenue of $1.93B grew 18.43% on strong subscription momentum
• Rising penetration of AEC and manufacturing cloud platforms
• Transition to the new transaction (agency) model progressing

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: revenue and earnings both beat with high double-digit growth, showing resilient design and make subscriptions, with cloud and AI features boosting stickiness. Near term the beat supports the stock. Mid term, track the new transaction model's impact on net revenue, AEC and manufacturing conditions, free cash flow conversion and operating margin expansion. Construction cycle and rates are the key swing factors; a ~29x P/E is reasonable.

Watch：AEC demand is sensitive to macro and interest rates; P/E of ~29x is not cheap; Revenue recognition volatility during the model transition
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 5.15%、營收年增 18.43%，雙雙強勁。
